task_description: Fix the chat surface to behave like a real chat and eliminate the silent no-response bug. Issue 1: composer Enter-to-send / Shift+Enter-newline (with IME guard). Issue 2 (most serious): a message to a working local model (Ollama qwen3) produced no reply and no error - root cause traced to send_message_inner using fail-fast providers::build_registry so any un-buildable provider row rejected the whole send, whose rejection the frontend swallowed; fix the backend to build the registry resiliently per-row AND make every send-path failure visible (rejected-send affordance + messageError reason rendering). Issue 3: render messages as a threaded, role-styled conversation view. Plus a spec update to Section 8.1. INTEGRATIONS_ONLY sandbox: no live Ollama and no crates.io/npm, so the live symptom cannot be reproduced here - traced in code, fixed at the most likely cause, and surfaced so the user's build reveals anything remaining.
